title: GGFlow: A Graph Flow Matching Method with Efficient Optimal Transport
authors_html: Xiaoyang Hou*, Tian Zhu*, Milong Ren, et al.
image_alt: Overview of the GGFlow graph flow matching framework
summary: Discrete flow matching with efficient optimal transport for graph generation. An edge-augmented graph transformer and a goal-guided framework steer generation toward desired properties.

title: GTAM: A Molecular Pretraining Model with Geometric Triangle Awareness
authors_html: Xiaoyang Hou*, Tian Zhu*, Milong Ren*, et al.
image_alt: Overview of GTAM molecular pretraining with geometric triangle awareness
summary: Geometry-aware molecular encoders connect 2D topology and 3D conformations. Two contrastive objectives transfer edge information between these views to improve molecular representations.
